question: What construction is the best of the twice-born instructed to make in relation to the mandapa?
premises: The instruction is addressed to the best twice-born
A gate hall is the object to be made
Its construction should follow the manner of a mandapa
inference: One should construct the gate hall in the manner of a mandapa.
plain_english: O best of the twice-born, one should make the gate hall in the manner of a mandapa.
